evals.prompt: I surveyed 25 classmates about their favorite fruit: apples 10, bananas 8, grapes 5, oranges 2. I need a circle graph with the angles.
evals.expected_output: Shows working for angles: 144, 115.2, 72, 28.8 summing to 360, percents 40, 32, 20, 8, checks totals, links the circle graph maker, adds title and one sentence.
assertions: Shows the angle working for at least one slice
Links the free circle graph maker or another tool page
Includes a title and a one-sentence reading

evals.prompt: I'm a teacher. I need five practice pie charts for my students with an answer key.
evals.expected_output: Points to the random pie chart generator for charts, explains keeping the key from the angle table, says practice data is made up.
assertions: Links the random pie chart generator page
Explains how to build the answer key from fractions and angles
States practice data is not real survey data
Does not claim the generator has features it was not told about
